description: Patterns registry. Source of truth for the symbolic vocabulary the IR refers to: logical features, first-order fragments, theory tags, axiom shape descriptors, concept tags, construction kinds, and adapter-capability vocabulary. Adding entries is non-breaking; renaming or removing entries is breaking and requires a registry version bump.

logical_features.description: Quantifier whose binder type is a function type.
An application has a predicate (a Prop-returning function) as an argument.
Equality whose carrier is a first-order type.
Equality whose carrier is a function type.
Equality at a quotient type (i.e. the quotient's notion of equality, which the underlying-type's quotient-equality principle witnesses).
Equality at an inductive type. Backend handling typically requires constructor injectivity / disjointness.
Goal involves induction-recursion (mutual definition of an inductive family and a recursor).
Sigma type appears in the goal or context.
Pi type with non-trivial dependency appears in the goal or context.

first_order_fragments.description: UF combined with linear integer arithmetic.
UF combined with linear real arithmetic.

theory_tags.description: Universal LIA sentences valid over Int are valid over instances of this type. Soundness backing: a verified embedding lemma in the home system.
Universal LRA sentences valid over Rat are valid over instances of this type.
Universal LRA sentences valid over Real are valid over instances of this type.
Universal BV sentences valid over a fixed-width bitvector are valid over instances of this type.
Type has a known finite cardinality.
Equality at this type is decidable.
Type carries a linear order with the usual axioms.
Type carries a well-founded relation enabling structural recursion / induction.

axiom_shape_descriptors.form: forall x y z. (x OP y) OP z = x OP (y OP z)
forall x y. x OP y = y OP x
forall x. E OP x = x
forall x. x OP E = x
forall x. x OP INV(x) = E
forall x y z. x OP1 (y OP2 z) = (x OP1 y) OP2 (x OP1 z)
forall x y z. R x y -> R y z -> R x z
forall x y. R x y -> R y x
forall x y. R x y -> R y x -> x = y
forall x y. R x y \/ R y x
forall args, y, z. R y z -> R (OP(.., y at N, ..)) (OP(.., z at N, ..))
forall x y. 0 <= x -> 0 <= y -> 0 <= x OP y

construction_kinds.description: Setoid-style quotient by an equivalence relation. Carries underlying_type, equivalence_relation, elimination_principle, equality_principle.
ADT-like inductive type with named constructors and a recursor (elimination_principle).
Coinductive type with destructors. v1 metadata schema parallels inductive.
Dependent pair Sigma x : A. B(x). Carries base_type and fibre_type.
Dependent function Pi x : A. B(x). Rare in v1; usually appears as a shell-level Forall instead.
Subset type {x : A | P(x)}. Carries base_type and predicate.
HIT with point and path constructors. v1 reserved; production support deferred to v2.

rewriter_passes.description: Boolean simplifications (P AND True -> P, P OR NOT P -> True, etc.) and trivial restructuring.
Unfolds defined functions whose definitional metadata's concept_tag is in the always-unfold list, using the recorded definitional_equation.
Reduces an equality in a quotient type to the underlying-type goal using the elimination and equality principles.
Bounded equality reasoning to canonicalize terms before backend dispatch.
Moves quantifiers outward; useful for backends that expect prenex normal form.
Replaces existentials with fresh function symbols.

maintenance.process: Adding entries: open a PR amending this file with a 'patch' bump to registry_version. Renaming/removing entries: requires a major bump and coordinated updates to schemas, adapters, and home-system plugins. Adapters that encounter unrecognized shapes should fall back to the explicit-axiom encoding rather than failing.
